mappings.note: Whose coming the 'umad ghumad' line reports (the clouds) -- a specific point located in the pad. Rejected LO-136, the skim-for-usefulness outcome.
Meaning of 'daamin' (lightning) -- a Braj word the learner must have taken from this pad. Rejected LO-137: the demand is lexical.
Meaning of 'mehaa' (rain) -- another Braj word. Rejected LO-137 on the same ground.
Whom Mira addresses in 'baso mere nainan mein Nandlal' -- located in the pad. Rejected LO-134: the addressee, not her idea.
In which month she sings his praise (Saavan) -- located. Rejected LO-134: a fact.

In which mode she offers her praise (bhakti bhaav) -- naming the devotional register these sung pads belong to. Mira's pads are sung devotional songs of the oral tradition, so the folk-song outcome is the nearest real home for items about their genre. Rejected LO-137: the mode is not a point in the text.
Whom 'Giridhar' names (Krishna) -- decoding an epithet. Rejected LO-137: the name is not explained in the pad.
What Mira hears in Saavan (the hint of Krishna's coming) -- located in the pad. Rejected LO-134: stated.
Who is to dwell in her eyes (Nandlal) -- located. Rejected LO-134, kept for the item asking what she is pleading for.
What his image is like (mohani and saanvari) -- the pad's own epithets. Rejected CG-HIN3: quoting them, not appraising the figure.
What rests on his lips (the murli). Rejected LO-140: the word is common, the placing is the answer.
Which garland adorns his breast (vaijayanti). Rejected CG-HIN3, kept for the item asking what it symbolises.
What Mira's lord is like -- giving joy to saints and loving his devotees: her claim about him. Rejected LO-137: the phrasing generalises past any one line.

Which month's cloud is raining -- located in the pad. Rejected LO-134: a fact. NOTE: the stored key is 'Vaishakh', but this pad is about Saavan, which two other items in this chapter key correctly, so this key is wrong.
What the Saavan cloud seems like ('man bhaavan') -- the pad's own word. Rejected LO-134: quoted.
What gathers from all four quarters (the clouds). Rejected LO-131: a fact, not a scene to render.
How the drops fall ('nanhi-nanhi') -- the pad's own epithet. Rejected LO-131: a detail.
What the wind is like (cool and pleasant) -- located. Rejected LO-140: the words are quoted, not glossed.

What Krishna's eyes are like -- located in the pad. Rejected LO-134: a described detail. NOTE: the correct option reads "both 'kha' and 'ga'" while the labels print as (A)-(D), so the referenced options cannot be matched to the labels shown.
Blank is 'murli' -- a word used throughout, so verse recall. Rejected LO-140: no lexical difficulty.
Blank is 'daamin' -- the Braj word for lightning is the demand. Rejected LO-137, kept for blanks that are ordinary words.
Blank is 'noopur', a literary word for anklets. Rejected LO-137 on the same ground.
Blank is 'sohaavan', an archaic adjectival form. Rejected LO-137: the form is the demand.
Blank is 'aanand mangal' in the closing line -- recall of a familiar pairing. Rejected LO-140: both words are plain.
Blank is 'prabhu' -- an ordinary noun. Rejected LO-140.
Blank is 'vishaal' -- an ordinary adjective. Rejected LO-140.
Blank is 'umagyo', an archaic verb form. Rejected LO-137: the form is the demand.
Meaning of 'adhar' (lips) in 'adhar sudha ras murli raajati'. Rejected LO-137: lexical.
When the shower of fine drops falls (in Saavan). Rejected LO-131: a fact.
Which natural event the 'daamin dam kai' line describes -- lightning and heavy rain, from the line. Rejected LO-131: the event is named, not rendered.
In which month the heart fills with joy (Saavan). Rejected LO-134: a fact.
Whom Mira worshipped -- placing her devotion within the Krishna-bhakti tradition these sung pads belong to. Rejected LO-137: not a point inside the verse.
When the hint of his coming reaches her (when the Saavan clouds gather). Rejected LO-134: stated.
On what Mira's pads rest (devotion to Krishna) -- a judgement about their genre and tradition. Rejected LO-136: the item asks their basis, not their usefulness.
Whom she calls 'bhakt vatsal' (Krishna) -- attribution of the epithet. Rejected LO-140, kept for the items that unpack what the epithet asserts.

Which ALANKAR 'mohani moorati saanvari soorati' carries (anupraas) -- naming a poetic device outright. Cited at goal level because no outcome among the 16 covers alankar: LO-138 is folk song and tale, and LO-140 concerns the learner's own use of words, not a poet's figures.
What the vaijayanti garland SYMBOLISES (his divinity) -- reading a poetic pratik. Cited at goal level for the same reason: none of the 16 outcomes covers poetic symbol.
Which quality of his eyes she is taken by -- their vastness, from the pad. Rejected LO-134: a described detail.
What Mira means by 'adhar sudha ras' -- the nectar of the flute at his lips, a phrase to be unpacked word by word. Rejected LO-134: the difficulty is the diction.
Whom she awaits and why -- her longing, which the pad implies rather than states. Rejected LO-137 for that reason.
